title: Gem Garden
tagline: Match gems, grow a garden — forty little gardens bloom into a moonlit wonder.
description: A cosy match-3 where every cleared level plants something new: tulips, an orchard, a lily pond and finally a glowing Moon Garden. Forty hand-designed levels with score, vine, bramble, seed and collection goals; Line Gems, Bloom Bombs and Prisms that combine into board-wide combos; cascades that climb a musical scale; a Garden Bonus that turns leftover moves into fireworks. Zen mode has no limits at all. No lives, no timers, no energy — just gardening.
controls: Swipe or tap two neighbouring gems to swap · Keyboard: arrows move, Enter selects, arrow to swap, H for a hint · Esc/P pause
fablePass: Music: gentle garden bed per zone (meadow, orchard, pond, moon), ducked under cascades
Plant growth: replace the scale-pop grow-in with staged sprout→bud→bloom animation
Gem idle: occasional glint sweep across random gems; special-gem creation flourish
Finale: choreographed Moon Gate opening and firefly swarm
Map: butterflies and bees following the path; character mascot walking to the next node
